geometryAndIdentity.source: Valley Metro — Bus Stops with Amenities (Juris='Phoenix')

ridership.fiscalYearNote: Quarters are FISCAL (July-June), not calendar. Inferred from the sibling layer RidershipDataPortal_Bus, whose earliest quarter Q2015_2 aligns with its own description 'bus stops as of October 27, 2014' only under a July-June year. Valley Metro publishes no data dictionary for the field.
ridership.quarterSelection: The base quarter is the latest quarter passing the completeness checks recorded under completenessChecks. Those checks are this project's own and are NOT independently reconciled; passing them does not establish that the quarter is complete.

checks.description: A quarter passes when its Phoenix weekday total and its count of reporting stops both stay within the stated share of the best-covered quarter examined.
checks.whatPassingDoesNotEstablish: That the quarter is complete. Without an independent control total these checks detect only partial extracts and collapsed totals; a quarter that under-reports uniformly across every stop passes both and is undetectable here. Valley Metro publishes no completeness flag, no data dictionary and no revision notice for this layer.

failures: weekday total is 38% of the best quarter (minimum 60%)
weekday total is 11% of the best quarter (minimum 60%)
weekday total is 5% of the best quarter (minimum 60%)

ridership.periodMismatch: The ridership period (Apr-Jun 2024) does not match the GTFS schedule (July 2026) or the thermal analysis date. This is the temporal-drift scenario dimension, not a rounding error.
ridership.caveat: The layer does not state whether a value counts boardings only or boardings plus alightings. Exposure estimates built on it are an upper bound if alightings are included, since alighting riders do not wait.

scheduledService.source: Valley Metro GTFS static, via City of Phoenix Open Data (ODC-BY)
scheduledService.unit: scheduled departure minutes past the start of the service day, per route, for each of three day types

weekday.method: most frequent active-service set across dates of this day type (modal, not maximum-trip)

saturday.method: most frequent active-service set across dates of this day type (modal, not maximum-trip)

sunday.method: most frequent active-service set across dates of this day type (modal, not maximum-trip)

scheduledService.dayTypeNote: weekday / saturday / sunday are extracted separately. Weekend ridership is never paired with a weekday timetable. The service pattern for each day type is the MOST FREQUENT active-service set across the dates of that day type, not the date with the most trips.
scheduledService.caveat: Scheduled service, not observed service. Real-time deviation, cancellations and detours are not represented.

legacyRidershipIndex.source: City of Phoenix — Bus Stops, field RIDERSHIP
legacyRidershipIndex.caveat: No unit, period or collection date is published. Retained as a cross-check only; no product value is computed from it.

shelterStatus.caveat: Published amenity fields contradict Phoenix's own sheltered-stop total (3164 in FY2024-25). No null or zero is read as 'no shelter'.

dayTypes.note: Each analysis day type pairs its OWN timetable with the ridership category the source publishes for it. The published Weekend average is applied to Saturday and to Sunday separately because Valley Metro does not split the two; the timetables are genuinely different (Saturday 5,476 trips, Sunday 4,815).
